L1792: ## Trading endpoints
L1793: ### New order (TRADE)
L1794: 
L1795:     Code
L1796: 
L1797:     `POST /api/v3/order`
L1798: 
L1799: Send in a new order.
L1800: 
L1801: This adds 1 order to the `EXCHANGE_MAX_ORDERS` filter and the `MAX_NUM_ORDERS` filter.
L1802: 
L1803: Weight: 1
L1804: 
L1805: Unfilled Order Count: 1
L1806: 
L1807: Parameters:
L1808: Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description
L1809: --- | --- | --- | ---
L1810: symbol  | STRING  | YES  |
L1811: side  | ENUM  | YES  | Please see cite64†Enums for supported values.
L1812: type  | ENUM  | YES  | Please see cite65†Enums for supported values.
L1813: timeInForce  | ENUM  | NO  | Please see cite66†Enums for supported values.
L1814: quantity  | DECIMAL  | NO  |
L1815: quoteOrderQty  | DECIMAL  | NO  |
L1816: price  | DECIMAL  | NO  |
L1817: newClientOrderId  | STRING  | NO  | A unique id among open orders. Automatically generated if not sent. Orders with the same `newClientOrderID` can be accepted only when the previous one is filled, otherwise the order will be rejected.
L1818: strategyId  | LONG  | NO  |
L1819: strategyType  | INT  | NO  | The value cannot be less than `1000000`.
L1820: stopPrice  | DECIMAL  | NO  | Used with `STOP_LOSS`, `STOP_LOSS_LIMIT`, `TAKE_PROFIT`, and `TAKE_PROFIT_LIMIT` orders.
L1821: trailingDelta  | LONG  | NO  | See cite67†Trailing Stop order FAQ .
L1822: icebergQty  | DECIMAL  | NO  | Used with `LIMIT`, `STOP_LOSS_LIMIT`, and `TAKE_PROFIT_LIMIT` to create an iceberg order.
L1823: newOrderRespType  | ENUM  | NO  | Set the response JSON. `ACK`, `RESULT`, or `FULL`; `MARKET` and `LIMIT` order types default to `FULL`, all other orders default to `ACK`.
L1824: selfTradePreventionMode  | ENUM  | NO  | The allowed enums is dependent on what is configured on the symbol. The possible supported values are: cite68†STP Modes .
L1825: pegPriceType  | ENUM  | NO  | `PRIMARY_PEG` or `MARKET_PEG`. See cite69†Pegged Orders Info L1826: pegOffsetValue  | INT  | NO  | Price level to peg the price to (max: 100). See cite69†Pegged Orders Info L1827: pegOffsetType  | ENUM  | NO  | Only `PRICE_LEVEL` is supported. See cite69†Pegged Orders Info L1828: recvWindow  | DECIMAL  | NO  | The value cannot be greater than `60000`. Supports up to three decimal places of precision (e.g., 6000.346) so that microseconds may be specified.
L1829: timestamp  | LONG  | YES  |
L1830: Some additional mandatory parameters based on order `type`:
L1831: Type  | Additional mandatory parameters  | Additional Information
L1832: --- | --- | ---
L1833: `LIMIT`  | `timeInForce`, `quantity`, `price`  |
L1834: `MARKET`  | `quantity` or `quoteOrderQty`  | `MARKET` orders using the `quantity` field specifies the amount of the `base asset` the user wants to buy or sell at the market price. E.g. MARKET order on BTCUSDT will specify how much BTC the user is buying or selling. `MARKET` orders using `quoteOrderQty` specifies the amount the user wants to spend (when buying) or receive (when selling) the `quote` asset; the correct `quantity` will be determined based on the market liquidity and `quoteOrderQty`. E.g.
L1835: Using the symbol BTCUSDT: `BUY` side, the order will buy as many BTC as `quoteOrderQty` USDT can. `SELL` side, the order will sell as much BTC needed to receive `quoteOrderQty` USDT.
L1836: `STOP_LOSS`  | `quantity`, `stopPrice` or `trailingDelta`  | This will execute a `MARKET` order when the conditions are met. (e.g. `stopPrice` is met or `trailingDelta` is activated)
L1837: `STOP_LOSS_LIMIT`  | `timeInForce`, `quantity`, `price`, `stopPrice` or `trailingDelta`  |
L1838: `TAKE_PROFIT`  | `quantity`, `stopPrice` or `trailingDelta`  | This will execute a `MARKET` order when the conditions are met. (e.g. `stopPrice` is met or `trailingDelta` is activated)
L1839: `TAKE_PROFIT_LIMIT`  | `timeInForce`, `quantity`, `price`, `stopPrice` or `trailingDelta`  |
L1840: `LIMIT_MAKER`  | `quantity`, `price`  | This is a `LIMIT` order that will be rejected if the order immediately matches and trades as a taker. This is also known as a POST-ONLY order.
L1841: Notes on using parameters for Pegged Orders:
L1842:   * These parameters are allowed for `LIMIT`, `LIMIT_MAKER`, `STOP_LOSS_LIMIT`, `TAKE_PROFIT_LIMIT` orders.
L1843:   * If `pegPriceType` is specified, `price` becomes optional. Otherwise, it is still mandatory.
L1844:   * `pegPriceType=PRIMARY_PEG` means the primary peg, that is the best price on the same side of the order book as your order.
L1845:   * `pegPriceType=MARKET_PEG` means the market peg, that is the best price on the opposite side of the order book from your order.

L2086: ### Cancel order (TRADE)
L2087: 
L2088:     Code
L2089: 
L2090:     `DELETE /api/v3/order`
L2091: 
L2092: Cancel an active order.
L2093: 
L2094: Weight: 1
L2095: 
L2096: Parameters:
L2097: Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description
L2098: --- | --- | --- | ---
L2099: symbol  | STRING  | YES  |
L2100: orderId  | LONG  | NO  |
L2101: origClientOrderId  | STRING  | NO  |
L2102: newClientOrderId  | STRING  | NO  | Used to uniquely identify this cancel. Automatically generated by default.
L2103: cancelRestrictions  | ENUM  | NO  | Supported values: `ONLY_NEW` - Cancel will succeed if the order status is `NEW`. `ONLY_PARTIALLY_FILLED ` - Cancel will succeed if order status is `PARTIALLY_FILLED`.
L2104: recvWindow  | DECIMAL  | NO  | The value cannot be greater than `60000`. Supports up to three decimal places of precision (e.g., 6000.346) so that microseconds may be specified.
L2105: timestamp  | LONG  | YES  |
L2106: Notes:
L2107: 
L2108:   * Either `orderId` or `origClientOrderId` must be sent.
L2109:   * If both `orderId` and `origClientOrderId` are provided, the `orderId` is searched first, then the `origClientOrderId` from that result is checked against that order. If both conditions are not met the request will be rejected.
L2110: 
L2111: Data Source: Matching Engine
L2112: Response:
L2113: 
L2114:     Code
L2115: 
L2116:     `{
L2117:         "symbol": "LTCBTC",
L2118:         "origClientOrderId": "myOrder1",
L2119:         "orderId": 4,
L2120:         "orderListId": -1, // Unless it's part of an order list, value will be -1
L2121:         "clientOrderId": "cancelMyOrder1",
L2122:         "transactTime": 1684804350068,
L2123:         "price": "2.00000000",
L2124:         "origQty": "1.00000000",
L2125:         "executedQty": "0.00000000",
L2126:         "origQuoteOrderQty": "0.000000",
L2127:         "cummulativeQuoteQty": "0.00000000",
L2128:         "status": "CANCELED",
L2129:         "timeInForce": "GTC",
L2130:         "type": "LIMIT",
L2131:         "side": "BUY",
L2132:         "selfTradePreventionMode": "NONE"
L2133:     }`
L2134: Notes:
L2135: 
L2136:   * The payload above does not show all fields that can appear in the order response. Please refer to cite71†Conditional fields in Order Responses .
L2137:   * The performance for canceling an order (single cancel or as part of a cancel-replace) is always better when only `orderId` is sent. Sending `origClientOrderId` or both `orderId` + `origClientOrderId` will be slower.
